title: Composite Problem Solving Lab
prompt: Decide whether each part of a composite problem needs area, circumference, or perimeter, then justify the selected formulas.

checkpoints.label: Tried a multi-step solution before revealing

fallback.markdown: Use the lab to sort problem clues into area, circumference, and perimeter decisions. For each multi-step problem, choose formulas first, explain why each formula matches the measurement, then compute.
